news.headline: Crude oil slips ~1.2% (WTI $92.56, Brent $105.45)
news.what_happened: WTI fell 1.26% and Brent 1.13% in the latest session, though prices remain elevated.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude eases input costs for airlines, paints and tyres; mildly negative for upstream oil and OMCs.

news.headline: Asia weak: Nikkei -2.55%, Hang Seng -0.95%
news.what_happened: Japan and Hong Kong sold off; Nifty closed previous session down 0.7% at 22,363.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off tone in Asia and US 10Y yield near 5.24% weigh on EM flows and Indian large caps.

news.headline: US flat: S&P -0.06%, Nasdaq -0.44%
news.what_happened: Wall Street ended little changed with tech slightly lower; dollar index eased 0.18%.
news.why_it_matters: No strong cue for Indian IT; rupee steady at 95.76.

sector_outlook.reason: Weak Asia, no fresh China data

picks.logic: Jet fuel is a major share of IndiGo opex; falling crude is a direct cost tailwind.
Crude derivatives are a large share of paint raw material cost; lower crude supports margins.
Synthetic rubber and carbon black are crude-linked and form most of tyre input cost.
